# Film Point

> Movie discovery, ratings and watchlists. Data from TMDB.

Film Point is a movie discovery site: search films, browse curated genre hubs, read a
full page per film (synopsis, cast, runtime, ratings, FAQ) and keep a local watchlist.
Pages are prerendered to static HTML.

## Key pages

- [Home / discovery](https://filmpoint.vercel.app/): search plus trending, watchlist and popular titles
- [Genre hubs](https://filmpoint.vercel.app/genre/action): 19 pages, e.g. /genre/comedy, /genre/horror, /genre/science-fiction
- [Movie pages](https://filmpoint.vercel.app/movie/27205): one page per film with structured data and an FAQ
- [Sitemap](https://filmpoint.vercel.app/sitemap.xml) · [robots.txt](https://filmpoint.vercel.app/robots.txt)

## Notes for automated agents

- Content is server-rendered HTML; no JavaScript is required to read titles, ratings, cast, genres or the FAQ.
- Structured data is emitted as JSON-LD: `Movie`, `FAQPage`, `BreadcrumbList`, `CollectionPage`/`ItemList`, `WebSite` and `Organization`.
- Movie metadata comes from TMDB. Film Point does not host or stream video; "Watch"/"Download" links lead to third-party sites.
- Page counts: 1 home + 19 genre hubs + ~200 popular movie pages.
- Crawling is welcome; `/api/` is disallowed and there are no paywalls or interstitials.
